title: Early Dynastic Period in Egypt
description: Unification of Upper and Lower Egypt.

title: Great Pyramid of Giza completed
description: Tomb of Pharaoh Khufu, tallest structure for ~3,800 years.

title: Code of Hammurabi
description: One of the earliest preserved law codes.

title: Late Bronze Age collapse
description: Wave of civilizational collapses across the eastern Mediterranean.

title: First Recorded Olympic Games
description: First documented ancient Olympic Games.

title: Founding of Rome
description: Traditional date of the founding of Rome.

title: Roman Republic established
description: Rome transitions from monarchy to republic.

title: Battle of Marathon
description: Athenians defeat Persian invasion force.

title: Trial of Socrates
description: Socrates condemned to death; foundational moment for Western philosophy.

title: Alexander defeats Darius III
description: Battle of Gaugamela ends the Achaemenid Empire.

title: Qin unifies China
description: Qin Shi Huang founds the first imperial Chinese dynasty.

title: Assassination of Julius Caesar
description: Caesar killed on the Ides of March.

title: Roman Empire begins
description: Augustus becomes first Roman emperor.

title: Roman Empire (Western)
description: From Augustus to the deposition of Romulus Augustulus.

title: Han Dynasty
description: Long-lived imperial Chinese dynasty bridging the Qin and Three Kingdoms periods.

title: Eruption of Vesuvius
description: Pompeii and Herculaneum destroyed.

title: Paper standardized in Han China
description: Cai Lun documents standardized papermaking process.

title: Edict of Milan
description: Christianity tolerated across the Roman Empire.

title: Sack of Rome
description: Visigoths under Alaric sack the city of Rome.

title: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
description: Romulus Augustulus deposed by Odoacer.

title: Noah
description: Built the ark and survived the Flood (Genesis 6–9); lived 950 years per Ussher.

title: Genesis Flood (Ussher)
description: Global deluge in the 600th year of Noah (Genesis 7); Ussher's date.

title: Tower of Babel
description: Confusion of languages and dispersion of nations (Genesis 11).

title: Abraham
description: Patriarch of Israel; called from Ur, covenant of Genesis 12, 15, 17. Dates per Ussher.

title: Call of Abraham
description: Abraham leaves Haran for Canaan at age 75 (Genesis 12).

title: Isaac
description: Son of promise (Genesis 21); lived 180 years.

title: Jacob (Israel)
description: Father of the twelve tribes (Genesis 25–50); renamed Israel.

title: Joseph
description: Sold into Egypt, rose to vizier under Pharaoh; preserved Israel through famine (Genesis 37–50).

title: Moses
description: Lawgiver and prophet; led the Exodus and received the Torah at Sinai. Early-date confessional chronology.

title: The Exodus
description: Israel leaves Egypt under Moses (1 Kings 6:1 early-date chronology); Ussher places it 1491 BC.

title: Conquest of Canaan begins
description: Joshua leads Israel across the Jordan into the Promised Land (Joshua 3–6).

title: Period of the Judges
description: Cyclical apostasy and deliverance under judges from Othniel to Samuel.

title: Reign of Saul
description: First king of Israel (1 Samuel 9–31).

title: King David
description: Shepherd-king of Israel; covenant of an everlasting throne (2 Samuel 7); psalmist.

title: Reign of David
description: United monarchy; capital established at Jerusalem.

title: Reign of Solomon
description: Built the First Temple; wisdom literature; height of united kingdom.

title: First Temple completed
description: Solomon's Temple dedicated in Jerusalem (1 Kings 6); 480 years after the Exodus.

title: Kingdom divided
description: After Solomon, the kingdom splits into Israel (north) and Judah (south).

title: Elijah the prophet
description: Confronted Baal worship under Ahab and Jezebel (1 Kings 17 – 2 Kings 2).

title: Isaiah
description: Prophet to Judah under Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

title: Fall of Samaria
description: Assyria destroys the northern kingdom of Israel; ten tribes deported.

title: Jeremiah
description: Weeping prophet of Judah's final years and Babylonian exile.

title: Daniel in Babylon
description: Exiled noble, prophet, and statesman under Nebuchadnezzar through Cyrus.

title: Fall of Jerusalem
description: Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar destroys Solomon's Temple; Judah exiled.

title: Edict of Cyrus
description: Cyrus the Great permits the Jewish return to Jerusalem (Ezra 1).

title: Second Temple completed
description: Rebuilt under Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest (Ezra 6).

title: Nehemiah rebuilds the walls
description: Walls of Jerusalem restored under Persian governor Nehemiah.

title: Malachi prophesies
description: Last book of the Hebrew Bible; close of Old Testament canon.

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: Born in Bethlehem under Herod the Great (mainstream conservative dating); incarnate Son of God.

title: Birth of Christ
description: Nativity (Matthew 1–2; Luke 2). Conventional AD reckoning was off by ~4–6 years.

title: Crucifixion & Resurrection
description: Passion week in Jerusalem under Pontius Pilate; foundational event of Christianity.

title: Apostle Paul
description: Pharisee turned apostle to the Gentiles; author of much of the New Testament; martyred under Nero.

title: Destruction of the Second Temple
description: Romans under Titus sack Jerusalem and burn the Temple, ending the sacrificial system.

title: Revelation written on Patmos
description: Apostle John exiled under Domitian; receives the Apocalypse.
